description:
Makes the game's own screens faster to read and quicker to act in. No new windows, no new notifications: the vanilla Line Manager, Statistics, entity windows and construction menu simply show more and need fewer clicks.

Line Manager: vehicle count and 12-month balance per line, age per vehicle; remembers the selected line; asks before cloning or replacing several vehicles.
Line window: Add/Remove Vehicle buttons in the Vehicles card; a Stops card with waiting passengers per stop.
Statistics (Lines): quick filters (losing money, problems, no vehicles) and totals; correct sorting.
Windows: Statistics, Line Manager, Finances and others stay open side by side, also when you click the map; sections stay open; Sell asks first.
Towns: the level card names what limits growth. Company: locked perks explain a pending promotion.
Construction: Rail/Tracks and Road/Roads menus share their tabs; fastest track first; Configure opens the useful module tab; the bulldozer warns before removing a station in use.
Game bar: Earnings tooltip with the last 30 days. Vehicle store: newest models first.

Safe to add to and remove from savegames (UI only). Every change falls back to vanilla if it fails. English and German.

Source code and issue tracker: https://github.com/maxblan/ui-overhaul
name: UI Overhaul
summary: The vanilla screens show more and need fewer clicks: status in the Line Manager and Statistics, actions where you look, windows that stay open.
